dcat:Dataset.dct:description:
일반대학, 교육대학, 산업대학, 전문대학, 방송통신대학, 기술대학, 각종학교, 원격대학, 사이버대학 등 다양한 학제별 대학 관련 통계를 포함하고 있습니다. 시도별, 학제별 학교 상태와 주소, 연락처 등의 기본 정보와 함께 학과별 학위 과정, 계열 구분, 학생의 입학정원, 입학자수, 재학생 및 휴학생 수 등을 상세히 제공합니다. 또한 교직원의 전임 및 비전임 교원 수와 직원수를 기준일별로 분류하여 교육 현황 파악에 활용할 수 있도록 구성되어 있습니다.
<항목학교>
시도. 행정구, 학제, 학교상태, 본분교, 설립, 주야, 주소, 전화번호, 팩스번호, 홈페이지학과:학위 과정 구분, 계열 구분, 학과코드, 학과명, 학과수학생:입학정원, 입학지원자/입학자수, 재적학생(재학생, 휴학생)수, 외국인 유학생수 (학위과정, 연수과정), 졸업자수 * 하반기에는 재적학생과 외국인유학생만 제공함교직원:교원수(전임/비전임/시간강사), 직원수기준일:상반기(4월 1일), 하반기(10월 1일)

It includes statistics on various universities by discipline, including general universities, teacher's colleges, industrial universities, vocational colleges, open and correspondence universities, technical colleges, various schools, distance learning universities, and cyber universities. It provides detailed information on the status of schools by city and discipline, as well as basic information such as addresses and contact information, as well as degree programs by department, department classification, student admission quota, number of admitted students, and number of students on leave. It also organizes the number of full-time and part-time faculty and staff by base date so that it can be used to understand the educational status.
City. Administrative district, school system, school status, main branch, establishment, day and night, address, phone number, fax number, websiteDepartment: degree program type, department type, department code, department name, number of studentsStudents: admission quota, number of applicants/admitted students, number of enrolled students (current students, students on leave), number of international students (degree program, training program), number of graduates * In the second half of the year, only enrolled students and international students are providedFaculty: number of faculty (full-time/part-time/part-time instructors), number of employeesBase date: first half (April 1), second half (October 1)
